_comment: Hand-pinned canonical artist names. The key is the name to replace, the
value is the name to use. Matching is case- and diacritic-insensitive, so
This exists for artists whose different spellings are genuinely the same
performer. artist_names.py also derives aliases automatically from
MusicBrainz artist MBIDs, which is the preferred route -- this file is for
what MusicBrainz does not cover, or disagrees with.
